newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia's SBI index jumps on cenbank decision.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia's SBI index jumps on cenbank decision.

text.p: Slovenia's SBI index closed two percent higher on Friday as the market welcomed the decision by the Bank of Slovenia to ease rules for those who buy securities for a period of more than seven years.
* The SBI index jumped 24.91 points to 1,262.5.
* Food maker Droga was the most active, easing 1.03 percent to 28,000 tolars on volume of 2,338 shares for total turnover of 63.6 million tolars.
* Preferred shares of trading firm Kovinotehna were the top gainers, jumping 8.97 percent to 425 tolars on volume of 200 shares. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
